name: Primitives/Segmented/Item
description:
One option of a Segmented (label, icon or both, optional Badge).


Building block of Segmented: place Segmented, not this primitive, one Item per option.

name: Segmented
description:
Switches between 2–5 mutually exclusive views or sections of the same content.


Use for
View switchers (grid ↔ list), section switchers with counters (Inbox · Mentions), a period switch.


Use something else
Filtering data → Chip/Advanced.
More than five options or long labels → Tab-Bar or Input/Select-Field.
Form answers → Radio-Button.


Properties
Level: Secondary (default) · Primary · Black-Overlay (the default on a colour band or photo: dark fill, light text) · White-Overlay (on a solid colour: light fill, light text); both select white with dark text and never change with the mode


Code: <Segmented> (Zen DS)

name: Toggle
description:
A switch with its label: turns a setting on or off with immediate effect.


Use for
Settings that apply at once (notifications, sync).


Use something else
Choices that apply on Save → Checkbox.
One of several options → Radio-Button or Segmented.


Properties
Theme: Text-First (label left) · Toggle-First
Size: Small · Medium · Large (phones: Medium or larger) · XLarge (48px, the one setting that leads a screen; its Toggle-Button holds an icon in the dot: Icon / Icon-Src, Light while off, Strongest while on)
Select: No · Yes


Code: <Toggle> (Zen DS)

name: Toggle-Button
description:
The bare switch without a label.


Building block of Toggle: place Toggle, not this primitive, unless the label sits elsewhere (a List-Item's trailing on a static row, a table's Control-Cell).

name: Badge
description:
A non-interactive label for a status, category or attribute (Live, Failed, Draft).


Use for
Statuses in tables and lists (Badge-Cell), categories, short attributes.


Use something else
Selectable filters → Chip.
Values chosen inside a field → Tag.
Counts → Badge-Counter.


Properties
Theme: the colour family; pick it by meaning (Green done, Red failed, Yellow waiting), Neutral for plain labels
Background: Subtle (default, text in the family's Strongest) · Solid (high emphasis, On-Colors text)
Size: XSmall–Medium; match the row's text size


Rules
Never colour alone: the text says the status.
Keep it to one or two words.


Code: <Badge> (Zen DS)

name: Badge-Counter
description:
A small count (unread, items) attached to a navigation item, tab, chip or icon.


Use something else
A status or label → Badge.
A count that only says something is new → the Notification-Dot.


Properties
Theme: Accent or Red for attention, Neutral for plain totals
Size: XSmall–Medium, one step smaller than its host's text


Code: <BadgeCounter> (Zen DS)

name: Avatar/Stack
description:
Overlapping avatars for people sharing something (at most five, then +N).


Properties
Number: 1–5
More: the +N counter


Code: <AvatarStack> (Zen DS)

name: .Primitives/Avatar/Status/XSmall/Disabled
description: Visual representation of a user, team, or entity.
